description: Muhammad Qasim Pasta, Moid Raza Khan and Fatima Aslam at Habib University publish a Karachi bus network assembled from routes for 76 public buses, including BRT services and minibuses. They obtained route descriptions from Travel Culture and HamariWeb and stop coordinates from Google Maps, then cleaned node and edge attributes for network and QGIS analysis. The October 2024 Zenodo deposit provides GraphML, node and edge CSV tables, and an R script for generating the network. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. This city-scale topology can initialise public-transit network simulations or accessibility and route-planning comparisons. The metadata do not state survey dates, headways, passenger demand or a complete inventory of Karachi services. Coverage is therefore the assembled route collection, not a verified current transit feed. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
